The Supabase JWT finding no longer exists on main (client removed).

items.note: Suppression justification is backed by the existing test 'treats regex characters in the input literally instead of throwing'. semgrep --config auto on the changed files: 0 findings (was 14). YAML for all workflows and dependabot.yml parses.
